entities.name: CodePipeline
entities.rationale: Orchestrates the entire software delivery pipeline, labeled CODEPIPELINE

entities.name: CodeCommit
entities.rationale: Source control repository where developers commit code

entities.name: CodeBuild
entities.rationale: Compiles source code and runs tests, producing a deployable container image

entities.name: CloudFormation
entities.rationale: Deploys infrastructure and application resources using templates

entities.name: Registry
entities.rationale: Stores built application container images, labeled REGISTRY

entities.name: VPC
entities.rationale: Target network environment representing the deployment destination for resources

entities.name: ECS
entities.rationale: Container service deployed inside the VPC container box

entities.name: IAM
entities.rationale: Manages roles and permissions inside the VPC container box

entities.name: ALB
entities.rationale: Applies traffic routing, located inside the VPC container box

entities.name: Dev
entities.rationale: Developer starting the workflow by committing code

visual_connections.description: Developer commits code modifications into the source repository
Triggers container compilation process upon new commit
Pushes the compiled image to ECR Registry
Deploys resources (ECS, IAM, ALB) consistently inside the target VPC
